title: eupatorium cruciatum
intro: Eupatorium cruciatum, commonly known as White Snakeroot, is a flowering plant native to eastern North America. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including treating fever, rheumatism, and sore throats. The therapeutic actions of White Snakeroot are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation and act as an antispasmodic, making it useful for relieving muscle and joint pain. The bioactive constituents of White Snakeroot include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
